## Type

Choose the closest fit:

- [ ] Open question
- [ ] Hypothesis
- [ ] Counterexample / disproof
- [ ] Reproduction
- [ ] Proof review
- [ ] Literature connection
- [ ] Computational result
- [ ] Bug / correction
- [ ] Other

## Question or claim

State it as precisely as you can.

## Current evidence status

KNOWN / REPRODUCED / OBSERVED / HYPOTHESIS / OPEN / DISPROVEN / unsure

## Evidence or reason to investigate

What did you observe, compute, derive, or read?

## Scope

Which runner counts, speeds, parameters, or assumptions are involved?

## Reproduction / source

Commands, data, derivation, citation, or minimal example.

## What could prove this wrong?

If applicable, describe a useful falsification test.

## AI involvement

If AI materially contributed to the claim or analysis, briefly say how.

## Notes

Anything else a reviewer should know.
